reasoning: This icon is standard UI chrome for toggling alphabetical sort order (A-Z ascending/descending) composed of letters and directional carets. In a task planner, tasks always have a concrete object being organized (books, files, spreadsheets, spices) which is a much better visual cue than an abstract sorting control.
